listing.name: God of War II HD — GoW2 Recomp (andrebrumdev) (andrebrumdev)
listing.summary: Upstream reports Rhodes and the Colossus fight at 45–60 FPS. A shoulder-bone bug remains, and later progression is not fully confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation Network NPUA80491 PKG and RAP, with decrypted EBOOT and USRDIR. The exact revision is unspecified; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source/setup-kit instructions to decrypt your own files, translate code and build locally. The project uses a SwiftUI launcher.

warnings: Upstream reports Rhodes and the Colossus fight at 45–60 FPS. A shoulder-bone bug remains, and later progression is not fully confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
